posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina's team has shut down comeback rumors, calling reports of her OTT debut 'speculation and misinformation.' Meanwhile, she's reportedly in talks for Chandni Bar 2 alongside Tabu.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Main Vaapas Aaunga with AR Rahman hits theaters today! Diljit also shared BTS photos from Sardaar Ji 3 with Neeru Bajwa, releasing June 27.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alpha teaser crossed 75M+ views in 24 hours! Alia's action-packed YRF Spy Universe debut releases July 3. Film critic Anupama Chopra says her Cannes trolling was a paid campaign.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Ranked #3 on Fortune India's Most Valuable Celebrities 2026 — the only woman on the standalone cover. Currently shooting SS Rajamouli's Varanasi with Mahesh Babu.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: King is confirmed for Christmas 2026 (Dec 24) release! The ₹350-crore action thriller co-stars daughter Suhana Khan in her theatrical debut, with Abhishek Bachchan as villain.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena teams up with Ayushmann Khurrana for Meghna Gulzar's hard-hitting Daayra, based on the 2019 Hyderabad case. The actress is vacationing in London with Saif.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Eetha release locked for August 28! Shraddha plays legendary Marathi folk performer Vithabai in this Maddock Films biopic. Also in talks for Mahavatar opposite Vicky Kaushal.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika and Ranveer announced their second pregnancy with an adorable photo of daughter Dua! Their ₹119-crore sea-facing Bandra mansion next to Mannat is nearing completion.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Dhurandhar 2 is heading to JioHotstar after collecting ₹1,800 crore worldwide — the second-highest-grossing Indian film ever. Baby #2 on the way with Deepika!

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya made her 24th Cannes appearance with a bold sindoor statement in a Banarasi saree, recreating her iconic 2002 debut. Daughter Aaradhya joined her on the red carpet.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika's action-thriller Mysa has completed its fifth schedule with a teaser coming soon. She's also reuniting with Allu Arjun in Atlee's massive sci-fi film AA22xA6.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Maa Inti Bangaaram releases June 19! Samantha produced and stars in this family action drama where she performs stunts in a saree. The trailer has generated strong buzz.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun is reportedly teaming up with Lokesh Kanagaraj for a massive sci-fi project. He's also shooting Atlee's AA22xA6 with Deepika, Rashmika, and Janhvi in the cast.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Peddi is dominating box office with ₹161+ crore in its first week! Ram Charan says working with Janhvi Kapoor and Shruti Haasan felt as joyful as Naatu Naatu with Jr NTR.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR faces off against Hrithik Roshan in War 2, releasing August 14. The highly anticipated dance-off sequence between the two superstars was recently filmed at YRF Studios.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi is riding the Peddi wave with Ram Charan — the film crossed ₹161 crore in its opening week. She's also in Allu Arjun-Atlee's AA22xA6 and may sign a third Telugu film.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: A viral video of Ananya dancing with dad Chunky Panday at the Zee Cine Awards is winning hearts. She's filming Call Me Bae Season 2 for Amazon and has Chand Mera Dil in theaters.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara stars alongside Hrithik Roshan and Jr NTR in War 2, releasing August 14. She's also paired with Yash in Geetu Mohandas' dark thriller Toxic.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik signs with Hollywood agency Anonymous Content! War 2 with Jr NTR releases August 14, and Krrish 4 pre-production is in full swing for a 2027 release — his directorial debut.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai with dad David Dhawan hits theaters today (June 12)! The rom-com with Pooja Hegde and Mrunal Thakur is classic Dhawan family entertainment.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya kicks off The Unstoppable Tour in Auckland June 20, heading to Sydney, Melbourne, and 16 more cities across 6 countries. She also released the devotional single 'Siddha Bhajo.'

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman's Main Vaapas Aaunga soundtrack with Imtiaz Ali and Diljit releases in theaters today. The refugee-dedicated track 'Kya Kamaal Hai' is getting critical acclaim.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Jana Nayagan, Vijay's final film before full-time politics, faces a piracy crisis with a full HD leak. Rajinikanth and Kamal Haasan condemned the leak as the release awaits clearance.
